evidence.title: Keliru, Vaksin Covid-19 Mengandung Microchip yang Bisa ...
evidence.snippet_en: Tempo.co rated the claim "Vaksin Covid-19 mengandung microchip yang bisa menyalakan lampu" as "Keliru" (Wrong), stating that COVID-19 vaccines do not contain microchips.

evidence.title: Vaksin Covid-19 tidak mengandung microchip magnetik
evidence.snippet_en: Periksa Fakta rated the claim "Vaksin Covid-19 mengandung microchip magnetik" as "Salah" (False), concluding that COVID-19 vaccines do not contain magnetic microchips.

evidence.title: [Fakta atau Hoaks] Benarkah Bill Gates Bikin Vaksin Corona yang ...
evidence.snippet_en: Tempo.co rated the claim "Bill Gates membuat vaksin virus Corona Covid-19 yang dipasang microchip" as "Keliru" (Wrong), stating that Bill Gates did not create a COVID-19 vaccine with microchips.

evidence.title: Vaksin Covid-19 Mengandung Magnet dan Microchip, Mitos atau ...
evidence.snippet_en: Suara.com rated the claim "Vaksin Covid-19 Mengandung Magnet dan Microchip, Mitos atau Fakta?" as "Salah" (False), indicating that COVID-19 vaccines do not contain magnets or microchips.

evidence.title: Keliru, Konten tentang Pemasangan Microchip Melalui Vaksinasi di ...
evidence.snippet_en: Tempo.co rated the claim "Konten tentang Pemasangan Microchip Melalui Vaksinasi di Indonesia" as "keliru" (wrong), concluding that claims about microchip implantation via vaccination in Indonesia are false.

evidence.title: [Fakta atau Hoaks] Benarkah Vaksin Covid-19 Tanamkan Microchip ...
evidence.snippet_en: Tempo.co rated the claim "Vaksin Covid-19 akan menanamkan microchip yang diprogram untuk membantai 7,5 miliar nyawa dan melakukan perbudakan global" as "Keliru" (Wrong), debunking the microchip conspiracy.

evidence.title: Keliru, Vaksin Covid-19 Terkait dengan Jaringan 5G dan Sebabkan ...
evidence.snippet_en: Tempo.co rated the claim "Vaksin Covid-19 dapat menyebabkan efek jangka pendek berupa lumpuh dan meninggal, efek jangka panjang berupa wabah penyakit baru, dan terkait dengan chip serta jaringan 5G" as "Keliru" (Wrong).

evidence.title: COVID-19 Vaccines Don't Have Patient-Tracking Devices
evidence.snippet_en: FactCheck.org rated the claim "COVID-19 vaccines have a microchip that "tracks the location of the patient."" as "False", concluding that COVID-19 vaccines do not contain patient-tracking devices.

evidence.title: Health Sensors Misconstrued as Government Tracking 'Microchips'
evidence.snippet_en: FactCheck.org rated the claim "A new report from '60 Minutes' includes an interview with a scientist from the Pentagon who says that there is now a COVID microchip" as "False", clarifying that health sensors are misconstrued as microchips.

evidence.title: Magnet Videos Refuel Bogus Claim of Vaccine Microchips
evidence.snippet_en: FactCheck.org rated the claim "Videos of magnets sticking to arms prove that the COVID-19 vaccines contain microchips" as "False", debunking the idea that magnets prove microchips in vaccines.

evidence.title: FDA-Approved ‘Electronic Pill’ Isn't Evidence That COVID-19 ...
evidence.snippet_en: FactCheck.org rated the claim "“Another Conspiracy Proven True!” referring to 2018 remarks by Pfizer CEO and claims about microchips in COVID-19 vaccines" as "False", clarifying the Pfizer CEO's remarks were not about COVID-19 vaccines.

evidence.title: Conspiracy Theory Misinterprets Goals of Gates Foundation
evidence.snippet_en: FactCheck.org rated the claim ""Bill Gates will use microchip implants to fight coronavirus."" as "False", stating that the conspiracy theory misinterprets the goals of the Gates Foundation.

evidence.title: Spoof Video Furthers Microchip Conspiracy Theory
evidence.snippet_en: FactCheck.org rated the claim "A microchip reader for pets detected a chip in the arm of a woman vaccinated against COVID-19" as "False", explaining that a spoof video furthered the microchip conspiracy theory.

evidence.title: Hoax about Bill Gates' plan to 'microchip the vaccine' circulates online
evidence.snippet_en: AFP Fact Check rated the claim "Bill Gates’ “ultimate goal” is to microchip COVID-19 vaccine in order to create virtual IDs" as "1" (False), concluding it is a hoax.

evidence.title: Hoax posts about microchips in Pfizer-BioNTech Covid-19 vaccine ...
evidence.snippet_en: AFP Fact Check rated the claim "Video of microchip found in Pfizer vaccine" as "Missing context", indicating that posts about microchips in Pfizer-BioNTech Covid-19 vaccine are hoaxes.
